sections_en.text:
This document 
sets out 
the P1 inspection steps 
 every five years 
Y5
for dry chemical powder fire extinguishers of
6 kg, 
12 kg capacity; dry chemical powder is used to extinguish all types of fire

Mr. Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and the Company's MPIS Coordinator, approved this document, and it was attested by Mr. Mahmoud Suleiman, Accountant, General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the East Delta Electricity Production Company

rows:
Issue an approved work order 
 from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Cordon off the area and place warning signs

Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment
 (safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, overalls, etc.)
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, etc.

Tool bag consisting of a set of spanners (open-end
, ring) and assorted screwdrivers

Body test unit
, dryer

Collect
 the cylinders at the extinguisher body test unit

Fill
 the cylinders with water using the unit's water pump, then 
 fit
 the coupling to the cylinders

Move
 the test valve to the 
 Test
 position and open
 the test water source and the main air source

Operate 
 the body test unit to start the test for 5 units in one batch up to a pressure of 35 bar
Leave

Remove the powder cylinders, 
 empty them
 of water and dry them
 thoroughly with a special dryer.

Refill 
 the powder cylinders with new powder and check that 
 their pressure is now correct
Lead-seal the valves of the cylinders

Inspect 
 the powder hoses and check that there are no cracks in them

Carry out 
 the necessary scraping and painting of the extinguisher body

Affix 
 the sticker
 showing the test date
